# Fuzzer biased toward ties, controller triggers, tiny rank spaces
import json, random, subprocess, sys
PROG="/app/submission/scheduler.py"; REF="/app/tmp/ref.py"
def gen_stream(rnd):
    Q = rnd.randint(1,4); L = rnd.randint(1,3)
    U = rnd.choice([1,2,3,4,6,8]); R = rnd.randint(1, U)
    borders=[0]
    if R>1:
        borders += sorted(rnd.sample(range(1,U), R-1))
    borders.append(U)
    assert len(borders)==R+1
    cap = rnd.choice([1,2,3,50])
    E = rnd.choice([0,1,1,2,3,5])
    nsteps = rnd.randint(0,40)
    t=0; steps=[]; nid=0; ids=set()
    for k in range(nsteps):
        t += rnd.randint(1,3)
        n = rnd.randint(0,L)
        lanes = rnd.sample(range(L), n)
        arr=[]
        for ln in lanes:
            arr.append({"id":"q%d"%nid,"lane":ln,"rank":rnd.randrange(U)}); nid+=1
        rnd.shuffle(arr)
        steps.append({"t":t,"serve":rnd.random()<0.7,"arrivals":arr})
    return {"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
            "capacity":cap,"epoch":E,"steps":steps}
def gen_burst(rnd):
    Q = rnd.randint(1,4); L = rnd.randint(1,3)
    U = rnd.choice([1,2,3,4,6,8,20]); R = rnd.randint(1, U)
    borders=[0]
    if R>1: borders += sorted(rnd.sample(range(1,U), R-1))
    borders.append(U)
    n = rnd.randint(0,120)
    packets=[{"id":"b%d"%i,"lane":rnd.randrange(L),"rank":rnd.randrange(U)} for i in range(n)]
    return {"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
            "start_bank":rnd.randrange(Q),"packets":packets}
def run(prog,data):
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B",prog],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return r.returncode,r.stdout
bad=0
N=int(sys.argv[1]); seed0=int(sys.argv[2])
for it in range(N):
    rnd=random.Random(seed0+it)
    req = gen_stream(rnd) if rnd.random()<0.5 else gen_burst(rnd)
    data=json.dumps(req).encode()
    rc,out=run(PROG,data)
    if rc!=0: print("FAIL rc",rc,json.dumps(req)[:500]); bad+=1; continue
    got=json.loads(out)
    rc2,out2=run(REF,data); exp=json.loads(out2)
    if got!=exp:
        bad+=1; print("MISMATCH seed",seed0+it,json.dumps(req)[:800])
        open("/app/tmp/mm%d.json"%(seed0+it),"w").write(json.dumps(req))
        if bad>3: break
        continue
    if req["mode"]=="burst":
        for rg in got["ranges"]:
            if rg["observed"]>rg["bound"]:
                print("CERT VIOLATION",rg,json.dumps(req)[:400]); bad+=1
    else:
        f=got["final"]
        assert f["totals"]["accepted"]==f["totals"]["departed"]+sum(len(q) for q in f["queues"])
print("done bad=",bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PYEOF
